g.text: Shoukang east warm room: photo-supported scope
2024 publication • p.142 / PDF p.4 • photograph credit: Wen Ming (文明)
Broad silhouette only; no literal ornamental tracing.
B. Two broad horizontal upper registers
Plain bands and frame divisions; no invented carving.
C. North-wall niche / recessed timber frame
Large spatial composition, not an applied tiny panel.
Depth is a reversible support fit, not a measured altar.
Exact dimensions, hidden construction, ritual inventory.
Buddhas, offerings and unreadable motifs are not modeled.
Original 399 × 381 image shown in full; boxes are coarse reading guides, not survey measurements. Separate from 2018 central seat/screen.
